The Grant to Developer line shows a $700,000 budget with no appropriations, encumbrances, or expenditures as of 12/31/2024 (annual report p.164).
what_is_not_established: Completion status: the 'Completion Status' field is blank (annual report p.163).
Whether the project is within budget or on schedule: the check-box answers cannot be read from the extracted text.
tid-annual-report-2024.next_evidence_needed: 2025 Annual Report of Tax Incremental Districts (expected DCD communication)
limitations: Periodic status report; it reports on, but does not amend, the Project Plan.

tid121-amendment-1-2026.neutral_summary: The 2024 Project Plan set TID Capital Project Costs at an up-to amount of $700,000 (plan p.5). Amendment No. 1 (2026) sets TID Capital Project Costs at $2,345,000, adding an up-to $1,645,000 grant to the Developer/Commercial Owner (amendment p.3). The later document revises the City's stated contribution; the record supplied does not state why.
what_is_established: 2024 Project Plan, Table A: TOTAL Capital Project Costs $700,000, up-to amount (plan p.5).
Amendment No. 1: the City shall fund an estimated $2,345,000 in TID Capital Project Costs (amendment p.3).
Amendment No. 1, Table A: adds Grant to Project (Monetary Obligation to Developer/Commercial Owner) $1,645,000, up-to amount (amendment p.3).
what_is_not_established: Why the amendment was needed; the supplied record does not state a reason.
Whether any of the 60 housing units are built or occupied; no supplied record addresses construction or occupancy.
Whether any grant funds have been disbursed after 12/31/2024; the latest supplied status report is the 2024 Annual TID Report.
tid121-amendment-1-2026.next_evidence_needed: 2025 Annual Report of Tax Incremental Districts (expected DCD communication)
limitations: Both figures are up-to ceilings, not amounts spent.
This is a comparison of two public documents, not a finding about performance or conduct.
